lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with narrower gaps between lines 4 through 7 at the center of the torso mass compared to the anterior and posterior regions.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th line from the anterior at approximately mid-flank. A secondary convergence point is observed on the 6th line in the lower ventral quadrant of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the shoulder. The 10th and 11th lines at the posterior terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral line of the belly.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of three distinct white spots is located on the posterior haunch, situated inferior to the vertical line pattern and superior to the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, forming a semi-connected geometric segment across the upper thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white horizontal bands (stockings) are visible on the lower segments of the forelegs and hindlegs. A white chevron-shaped marking is visible on the bridge of the muzzle.
